free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month,: 100 requests a month with forward geocoding, reverse geocoding and HTTPS encryption, and no support
free_tier.notes: the paid plans start at USD 9.99 a month,000 requests; batch requests start at the Professional plan, USD 49.99 a month for 1,000,000 monthly requests; the vendor's GitHub README still names 25,000 monthly requests, which the pricing page no longer offers

per_object_cap.stated: no batch geocoding on the Free plan: batch POST requests that carry several queries start at the Professional plan; the Free plan geocodes one query a request

retention.stated: results are licensed for display to the end users of the application

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS GET to api.positionstack.com/v1/forward and /v1/reverse with an access_key query parameter; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 missing_access_key
chaining: 100 requests a month on a personal, key is enough to test the API and not to run a service

limits.value: 100 requests a month on the Free plan; at the limit the API answers HTTP 429 usage_limit_reached
unverified: the size of the short-period limit is not published; the API answers HTTP 429 rate_limit_reached

binding_note: 100 requests a month are spent before any short-period rate limit matters

identity_cost.detail: an APILayer account (one account and one API key for every APILayer API); registration collects a full name, an email address, a password and address details, and the sign-up page says no card is required

reliability_note: at 100 requests the API answers HTTP 429 usage_limit_reached until the next monthly period; the Free plan has no support; older vendor pages still state 25,000 requests a month, which the current pricing page does not offer
confidence_note: the pricing page, the product page, the home page, the terms, the privacy statement, the docs and the sign-up page were quoted on 2026-11-02; a keyless call answered HTTP 401. No account was opened, so the free monthly quota and the sign-up fields were not exercised.
